title: Final Thickness
description: Essential Criteria: The correct thickness of the TiO2 film must be calculated and stated in microns.

title: Final Reflectivity
description: Essential Criteria: The correct reflectivity value must be calculated and stated.

title: Interference Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the condition for destructive interference in thin films.

title: Phase Shift Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the phase shift that occurs at the air-TiO2 interface.

title: Correct Wavelength Choice
description: Optional Criteria: The chosen wavelength should be appropriate for visible light and justify its selection.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent and correctly converted to microns.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the reflectivity calculation.
